integrity: The all-length claim follows from the support restriction and exact exhaustive finite coefficient computation, not numerical extrapolation. Source polynomiality and generic support decomposition are credited to preceding literature.
limitations: Only binary linear subspaces with maximum weight at most four; not all anticodes or larger diameters.
The finite support-by-rank coefficients are established by complete finite enumeration with independent exact implementations.
Historical priority remains provisional against differently titled exact enumerations.
title: Exact rank-and-support enumeration of binary linear diameter-four anticodes
